description: Blank sex is reported as its own group alongside the other sexes.

a.request: Matching laboratory records to their patient on `ID` (lab records with no matching patient are dropped), compute for each patient (by ID and sex) the average prothrombin time (`PT`) and the average of `IGA` − `IGM` per record, ignoring missing values. Also compute the mean of that IGA−IGM average across all patients, and divide each patient's IGA−IGM average by this overall mean. Then break the patients down by sex, keeping patients whose `SEX` is blank (an empty string) as a separate group of their own. For each sex, report the sex, the average of the patients' average PT, the average of their IGA−IGM averages, and the average of their ratios to the overall mean.
a.sql: WITH per_record AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.PT, (l.IGA - l.IGM) AS diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID), per_patient AS (SELECT ID, SEX, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM per_record GROUP BY ID, SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_mean FROM per_patient), ratios AS (SELECT pp.SEX, pp.avg_pt, pp.avg_diff, pp.avg_diff / o.overall_mean AS ratio FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_iga_minus_igm, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios GROUP BY SEX;

c.request: Matching laboratory records to their patient on `ID` (lab records with no matching patient are dropped), work out each patient's (by ID and sex) average prothrombin time (`PT`) and average `IGA` − `IGM` difference per record, ignoring missing values. Also work out how each patient's IGA−IGM average compares to the mean across all patients, as their average divided by that mean. Then break this down by sex: for each sex, give the average PT, the average IGA−IGM difference, and the average ratio to the overall mean. Blank sex is reported as its own group alongside the other sexes.
c.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT p.ID, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), 'Blank') AS sex_grp, l.PT, l.IGA - l.IGM AS iga_minus_igm FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID), per_patient AS (SELECT ID, sex_grp, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(iga_minus_igm) AS avg_diff FROM joined GROUP BY ID, sex_grp), with_ratio AS (SELECT ID, sex_grp, avg_pt, avg_diff, avg_diff / (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) FROM per_patient) AS ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT sex_grp AS sex, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_iga_minus_igm, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM with_ratio GROUP BY sex_grp;

b.request: Per patient (grouped by ID and SEX, with blank SEX as its own group), compute the average PT and the average per-record IGA−IGM difference over non-null values from Laboratory rows matched to Patient on ID; compute each patient's IGA−IGM average divided by the mean IGA−IGM average across all patients; then, for each SEX group (including blank), report the average PT, the average IGA−IGM difference, and the average of those ratios
b.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT p.ID, COALESCE(p.SEX, '') AS SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, COALESCE(p.SEX, '')), ratios AS (SELECT SEX, avg_pt, avg_iga_igm, avg_iga_igm * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm) FROM patient_stats) AS ratio FROM patient_stats) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_iga_igm) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios GROUP BY SEX

d.request: For laboratory records matched to patients on `ID` (dropping records with no matching patient), compute each patient's average prothrombin time (`PT`) and average `IGA` − `IGM` difference per record, ignoring missing values. Also compute each patient's IGA−IGM average divided by the mean IGA−IGM average across all patients. Then, grouped by sex, report the average PT, the average IGA−IGM difference, and the average ratio to the overall mean, treating blank sex as its own group alongside the other sexes.
d.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT p.ID, COALESCE(TRIM(p.SEX), '') AS sex_group, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_minus_igm FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, sex_group), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) AS overall_mean FROM patient_stats), ratios AS (SELECT ps.sex_group, ps.avg_pt, ps.avg_iga_minus_igm, ps.avg_iga_minus_igm / o.overall_mean AS ratio FROM patient_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall o) SELECT sex_group, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) AS avg_iga_minus_igm, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM ratios GROUP BY sex_group;
